notes.title: April Update (Karma System Expansion, Costume Retexture, etc.)
notes.content:
Hello Executioners.

While we wait for Season 1 and the Arena to open, an update has been completed with a variety of changes!


[h2]End of streaming mode support[/h2]

[b]Streaming mode support will end.[/b]
[i](What is streaming mode? When streaming mode is on, sensitive content such as CG with nudity will not be displayed.)[/i]
[list]
[*]Future content, as well as existing content, will no longer support streaming mode.
[*]Saves that already had streaming mode turned on will remain in that state until the next NG+ is started.
[*]The streaming mode selection option will no longer appear when starting a new game or starting NG+, and will default to OFF.
[*]Items that change streaming mode will be removed from the 'Other' category.
[/list]

[h2]Karma System Expansion[/h2]

The Karma system, which has been in its initial stages since its introduction, has been updated!

Here are more detailed information about the Karma system.
[list]
[*]The initial Karma value is '0', and it is reset when you start NG+.
[*]You can check the current Karma value in the gameplay statistics. [i](Examine the tombstone in the center of the graveyard.)[/i]
[*]Karma increases by 10 when you kill an NPC. [i](Dungeon/Mini-dungeon/Raid bosses are not NPCs.)[/i]
[*][b][New][/b] If the Karma value is 21 or higher, NPCs will reject gifts.
[*]If the Karma value is 41 or higher, fellows will reject recruitment. [i](Excluding DLC ​​fellows)[/i]
[*][b][New][/b] If you give the Harp of Return to Lily, your Karma will decrease by 30.
[*][b][New][/b] You can buy [b]Scissors of Karma[/b] at Helen's Gold bar Shop.
When you use [b]Scissors of Karma[/b], your Karma will decrease by 10.
[*][b][New][/b] You can purchase [b]Golden Scissors of Karma[/b] at Miss Jang's Shop.
[*][b][New][/b] Karma cannot decrease below 0.
[/list]

[h2]2nd NPC Visual Upgrade[/h2]

The second NPC visual upgrade has been completed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43799030/e22df58b9a7c130518ddf503bdf63e5548f984ce.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43799030/e87a510393e107379aff189429902406e4089e56.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43799030/6368005a08bf9ae4e30853eab4e6329e9c86ab78.png[/img]

The beneficiaries of this visual upgrade are [b]Poor Victim Mary[/b], [b]Weapon Dealer Anna[/b], and [b]Carrot-loving Banny[/b]. [i](The killable NPCs have also received new battle portraits.)[/i]

Visit the Graveyard to see the NPCs' cute new looks!


[h2]Costume Retexture Feature Trial Introduced[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43799030/bb40b2c5125b07675717c1560904b6f2427a70ae.png[/img]

There are currently [b]72 unique costumes in total[/b] in the game.

However, some of them have been out for a long time and have low usage rates and poor quality.

While new costumes will continue to be released in the future, I plan to [b]introduce costume retextures on a trial basis[/b] in order to preserve the value of existing costumes and expand the range of choices.

Costumes that support the retexture feature can be checked through a new marker in the Costume Encyclopedia.
[list]
[*][b]♠ (Yellow spade marker)[/b]: Retexture Available
[/list]Details on the Retexture feature are as follows:
[list]
[*]When using a costume, you can choose between the normal, retextured, and R18 versions, and [b]a preview is provided[/b].
[*]To change to the retextured and R18 versions, 3 gold bars are required [b]only once[/b].
[*]Retextures unlocked in the corresponding save file are [b]permanently available[/b].
[/list]I plan to gradually expand the costumes that support retexturing, and the unlock conditions may change in the future.


[h2]Ms. Jang's Shop Items Update[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43799030/c0270a26c58aa72fb10f3915286ab9fec67ff1c9.png[/img]

The mysterious girl, Ms. Jang's shop has been updated.

New items:
[list]
[*][b]Golden Scissors of Karma[/b]
[i]Magic scissors that can cut karma. You can manipulate karma at will. Unlimited use[/i]

[*][b]Fake Death Certificate[/b]
[i]Resets death count statistics and allows you to challenge Hardmode again.[/i]
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes and Other Changes[/h2]

Added a new marker to the Costume Encyclopedia - [b]♠ (Yellow Spade Marker)[/b]: Retexture Available

Fixed an issue where the correct animation would not play when Lily disappeared.

Fixed an issue where items could remain after giving Lily the Harp of Return.


The next major update will feature a new season and Arena content along with Patch 2.1.

I'm still developing and planning various other content, so please look forward to it!

Thank you.

notes.title: 2.0 Update: Added End Content "Raid"
notes.content:
Executioner Girls 2.0 update has finally arrived!

Check out the new features and new content below!


[h2]New Year Event Ended[/h2]

The New Year Event has ended!
[list]
[*]Enemies will no longer drop New Year Gift Box.
[*]Ms. Jang has stopped selling New Year Event Items and New Year Special Items.
[*]Event items will not be removed, and items you already own will continue to be available.
[/list]

[h2]Added Costume Encyclopedia[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43799030/5581f323a62b5ce002fa9c36db91d3f9f839cd54.png[/img]

[b]A Costume Encyclopedia has been added to the game![/b]

When you acquire a costume, it will automatically be recorded in the Encyclopedia.

Costumes that have not yet been discovered are marked with [b]"???"[/b], and you can check how to acquire them in the description.

[i](This includes costumes that can no longer be acquired due to limited-time events, etc.)[/i]

[b]Costume Encyclopedia Marker Description[/b]
[list]
[*][b]◆ (Green Diamond Marker)[/b] : Includes Style Change Feature
[*][b]▼ (Purple Inverted Triangle Marker)[/b] : Includes Color Change Feature
[*][b]● (Blue Circle Marker)[/b] : Limited-time event/DLC
[*][b]■ (Orange Square Marker)[/b] : Fellows-Only Costume
[/list]
Also, new markers have been added to the Weapon Encyclopedia.

[b]Weapon Encyclopedia Marker Description[/b]
[list]
[*][b]★ (Yellow Star Marker)[/b] : Special version of the original weapon
[*][b]● (Blue Circle Marker)[/b] : Limited-time event/DLC
[*][b][NEW] ▲ (Green Triangle Marker)[/b] : Super Rare
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43799030/1ab394f1fad95099fdb967626ce3a6bc8e7946e7.png[/img]

You can check the Weapon/Costume Encyclopedia by using the '[b]Guidebook[/b]' item in your inventory.

[h2]New Weapons & Armors[/h2]

These are the new equipment added in this update.
[list]
[*]Weapon: [b]Red Longbow[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43799030/653fc5890929c0dd95701760be10201f1667f35a.gif[/img]
[i]A longbow with a red string tied to it.
When in battle, gain the '[b]Pull Bowstring[/b]' buff for the first 2 turns.[/i]
[u][b]Pull Bowstring[/b]: ATK +20%, AGI +100%, Hit +30%, Critical +20%[/u]
(Can be obtained randomly from the [b]Ancient Vault[/b].)

[*]Weapon: [b]Piercing Rapier[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43799030/041a45089884f16154100a9f98ebc926b5d1785a.gif[/img]
[i]A weapon for those who dream of becoming world-class fencers.
Normal attacks are affected by the enemy's DEF by half.[/i]
(Obtained randomly from [b]Smuggler's Weapon Box[/b] or exchanged for [b]Smuggler Token[/b])

[*]Weapon: [b]Berserker's Battle Axe[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43799030/c4ac37d958221dc0a60dd1c7bf9435e44b16b922.gif[/img]
[i]A special version of the 'Battle Axe'. (Stun +10%)
When in battle, gain the '[b]Berserk[/b]' effect for 4 turns.[/i]
[u][b]Berserk[/b]: ATK +80%, MAT +80%, Damage received +50%[/u]
(Obtained randomly from [b]Smuggler's Weapon Box[/b] or exchanged for [b]Smuggler Token[/b])

[*]Weapon: [b]Golden Sword[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43799030/376405ac608746437a32c88248c74c8ceb554d51.gif[/img]
[i]The true original form of an old and dull sword. (Hit +10%)
When equipped, the '[b]Golden Blade[/b]' skill can be used.[/i]
[u][b]Golden Blade[/b]: All enemy targets, Ignores DEF, Can apply states abnormality of normal attack, cannot be avoided, MP 10, Cooldown 2 turns[/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43799030/71fffffdfd2a13621c3e562f12b1948e4b716ac9.gif[/img]
(Obtained randomly from [b]Smuggler's Weapon Box[/b] or exchanged for [b]Smuggler Token[/b])

[*]Weapon: [b]Magic Book of Negation[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43799030/bfb5a9edc9bc9976e63ca9de7bee001e0945a4b9.gif[/img]
[i]All existing skills cannot be used, but [b]skills unique to this book[/b] can be used.
MAT increases greatly, but Max MP is reduced by half.[/i]
[u][b]Negation of Metabolism[/b]: Deals weak magic damage to the enemy and stops the enemy's actions for 1 turn.[/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43799030/6d5835864663b9f87b43e1411a5414c3999808bf.gif[/img]
[u][b]Negation of Evasion[/b]: It makes an inevitable attack. The damage is low, but there is no cooldown.[/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43799030/b14d529f5b64a790643b7c06f3f0e0a86b908b2b.gif[/img]
[u][b]Negation of Purification[/b]: Deals weak magic damage to the enemy. Poisons the enemy, dealing 4% of their Max HP damage per turn.[/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43799030/96b4c7db3a2d511d15b6c08a6b3f9db1d4320858.gif[/img]
[u][b]Negation of Resist[/b]: Deals magic damage equal to the enemy's MDF in addition to your MAT.[/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43799030/0df823753ac2775ceebb799a9feb38affc2b37e6.gif[/img]
[u][b]Negation of Spell[/b]: Disables the target from using the skill for 3 turns. There is a low chance of failure, but it consumes less MP and has a short cooldown.[/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43799030/aa106065a55f25e26ac7dda668b069dba3d63a7d.gif[/img]
(Unlocked by purchasing [b]Weapon Pack[/b])

[*]Weapon: [b]Temple Knight's Armor[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43799030/a4b7faffb09fd22975e90e79df4d5aca83b20d34.gif[/img]
[i]Temple Knight's heavy armor. It is so heavy that it cannot hold a shield. (Growth Rate 25%)
Hit, Evasion, Magic Evasion -20%, AGI -80%[/i]
(Unlocked by purchasing [b]Weapon Pack[/b])

[*]Necklace: [b]Emerald Pendant[/b]
[i]Damage taken is reduced by 50% for the first 3 turns in battle.[/i]
(Exchange for [b]Raid[/b] rewards)

[*]Shield: [b]Jade Shield[/b]
[i]A shield with the mystical ability to block magic. Magic Evasion +20%[/i]
(Exchange for [b]Raid[/b] rewards)
[/list]

[h2]End content "Raid" added & Pre-season begins[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43799030/8d03e64b1ef2949dba1b5230e5283d34aa48b1be.png[/img]

The first end content, "[b]Raid[/b]", has been updated along with the opening of the pre-season!

Raid is seasonal, and the preseason will be held [b]until 2.1 update[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43799030/66847ccb3905833773a86129938feeadd41fcad8.png[/img]

Raid-related activities can be carried out after entering the Raid Room through the new NPC '[b]Ranun[/b]' in the graveyard.

[i](To meet Ranun, you must clear the game at least once.)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43799030/52e6efbbfa5a26a691227e15eba11eb03578f697.png[/img]

To challenge a raid, you need a '[b]Raid Ticket[/b]'.
Like the Mini Dungeon Ticket, it is not deducted if you lose.

[b]How to obtain a Raid Ticket[/b]
[list]
[*]Obtained by first entering the Raid Room (Once per NG+, excluding the first game)
[*]Dropped by the reinforced version enemy with a certain probability
[*]Purchased at Ms. Jang's Shop
[*]Obtained as an event reward, etc.
[/list]
In addition, you can choose from 3 to 4 difficulty levels to challenge the raid, and you can also check the boss's element, status, states resistance, and reward information for each difficulty.

The higher the difficulty, the more rewards you can get.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43799030/a1e02acc819fb34f4749ae6b34299243dea55d78.png[/img]

Here is the list of raid reward exchanges for this season.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43799030/98ff776fffbdc34d4f622145324cee07d99c77b6.png[/img][i](Fairy Queen Costume)[/i]

Check out the detailed description of each item in-game!
[i](Even if the season ends, previously acquired rewards and items in the exchange shop will not disappear.)[/i]


[h2]Ms. Jang's Shop Update[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43799030/7263a6543d4a16b20fd0f81902cb2c09e8ca6076.png[/img]

The mysterious girl, Ms. Jang's shop has been updated.

Removed items:
[list]
[*][b]New Year Gift Box[/b]
[*][b]New Year Costume Package[/b]
[*][b]New Year Special Items[/b]
[/list]New Items:
[list]
[*][b]Smuggler's Weapon Box[/b]
[i]A weapon box distributed by smugglers. You can't tell what's inside until you open it.[/i]
(You can check the acquisition probability of each item [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2358170/view/537721107195626006]Here[/url].)

[*][b]Raid Ticket[/b]
[i]Required when challenging a raid. It is not consumed when defeated.[/i]
[/list]The above items can be purchased in bundles at a discounted price.


[h2]Spring Sale & 2 New DLCs Released[/h2]

The Spring Sale will run for a week starting March 13th!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2358170

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2809940

During this period, the main game will be [b]25%[/b] off, and the integrated DLC 'Legacy Pack' will be [b]15%[/b] off.


https://store.steampowered.com/app/3551430

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3551440

Also, 2 new DLCs are out!

The [b]Weapon Pack[/b] includes 2 new weapons with unique playstyles, an exclusive costume for Chara, and various support items.

The [b]Raid Pack[/b] includes a lot of raid tickets, special consumables to help you in battle, and various support items!

Both DLCs are available with a [b]10%[/b] launch discount for 7 days.

(For more information about the items, including costume illustrations and weapon information, please check the DLC store page.)


https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/50807

[h3]Or purchase the Collector's Edition to complete your collection with [b]an additional 10% off![/b][/h3]


[h2]Bug Fixes and Other Changes[/h2]

Skills that inflict stun states, such as 'Stroke of Paralysis' and 'Earthquake', now have a cooldown of at least 1 turn. This change also applies to skills used by enemies.

Now, stun states reduce not only evasion rate but also magic evasion rate by 100%.

The skill 'Magic Blocking' that causes the silence states can now be evaded by the opponent instead of always succeeding.

Fixed an issue where some weapons that change their normal attack did not apply the states.

Fixed an issue where the ATK increase rate was abnormally high when upgrading the weapon 'Battle Axe'.

Enemies treated as boss monsters(Dungeon boss, NPC) now have 50% resistance to instant death.

Changed the attack type of some physical attack skills from magic damage to physical damage.

Changed the attack type of the 'Curse of Seal' skill to magic damage.

Fixed an issue where some enemy-only skills would ignore the silence states.
(Some skills can still intentionally ignore the silence states.)

Some skill icons have been changed.

Raid-related statistics have been added. These stats can be checked in the Raid Room.

Fixed the issue where the screen would briefly shake every time you entered the Training Room.

Fixed translation errors in some languages.


Thank you.

New statistics have been added.

[h2]Developer's Letter[/h2]

Hello, Executioners!
Although it's late, Happy New Year.

There were many difficulties when the development team was disbanded in the first half of last year and I switched to a one-person system, but I think I was able to stay as a developer until now thanks to your constant support and interest.

Whether I was alone or with team members, my next project was always postponed or stopped, but the fact that I never gave up on this first game that I made with my own hands and have been providing after-support for 20 months means a lot to me and makes me feel proud.

I would like to express my sincere gratitude to all of you who made this possible.

And now, I have some big news for you!

[h3][b]Upcoming 2.0 Update: Endgame Content Added[/b][/h3]

[b]As previously announced in development roadmap, a very challenging new PVE content is in development as the endgame content for the game![/b]

Since the official release, players' powers have continued to grow stronger with steady updates such as '[b]NG+ limit remove[/b]', '[b]Fellow's equipment limit remove[/b]', '[b]Added new equipment[/b]', and '[b]Added various mini-dungeons[/b]', but there was a lack of content that could utilize these stronger powers.

[list]

[*][b]Arena[/b]
You can participate with your fellows, but you [b]cannot use any items such as potions[/b].
Like Raid, it will be seasonal and will support a ranking board.
[/list]It is very unlikely that both contents will be added at the same time due to the schedule.

[h3][b]Main Game Price Increase[/b][/h3]

Also, the price of the main game will increase after this sale ends.

This is the first price increase since the Early Access launch, and new content and updates are still planned after the 2.0 update.

The increase is quite large, so please make sure to purchase the game while it is on sale!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2358170


That's all for this news.

Thank you.

Hello there, here’s a news at the October updates and new DLC for Halloween!


[h2]1st Anniversary Event Ended[/h2]

The 1st Anniversary Limited-Time Event has ended! Did you all enjoy the festival enough?

The event period was longer than expected, but many people participated in the 1st Anniversary Event!
[list]
[*]Enemies no longer drop 1st Anniversary Tokens and 1st Anniversary Gift Boxes.
[*]Sophie(Event NPC) in the village has returned to the kingdom.
[*]Ms. Jang has stopped selling 1st Anniversary items.
[*]The increased drop rate from regular monsters has ended.
[*]Event items will not be removed, and items you already own can still be used.
[/list]

[h2]Fellow's Equipment Restrictions Removed[/h2]

Are you the type that goes it alone, like a lone wolf?
If not, here’s some good news for you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43799030/dedea67506ba861a679fd2c69c9f589740b61f9e.png[/img]

Fellow's weapon, shield, and token equipment restrictions have been removed, so now you can equip your fellows with any type of equipment! And you can also equip a new equipment type, ‘[b]Gem[/b]’, which will be described later.

This change will allow all fellows to have the same performance as the player character.


[h2]New Equipment 'Gem'[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43799030/69aa577133067302a8f567f8678f8b2fb34c0598.png[/img]

A new equipment item, '[b]Gem[/b]', has been added to the game.
You can equip gems to enhance your character's abilities or gain powerful effects.

Gems are classified into four grades, and the minimum grade varies depending on the type.
[list]
[*][b]Normal[/b] (White)
[*][b]Rare[/b] (Green)
[*][b]Epic[/b] (Yellow)
[*][b]Legendary[/b] (Pink)
[/list]Gems can be obtained through the following methods:
[list]
[*]Obtained as a reward by clearing the 'Gem Cave' mini-dungeon.
[*]Obtained as rewards from various events.
[*]Purchase desired gems from Hellen's Gold Bar Shop.
[*]Purchase gem boxes from Ms. Jang's Shop.
[*]More will be added!
[/list]Only one gem can be equipped per character.


[h2]Mini Dungeon - Gem Cave[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43799030/f97fd1d6cf1b6e5f890b1eb8e648125e9527d850.png[/img]

The Gem Cave is the first mini-dungeon, and when cleared, you can obtain a random type and rarity of gem depending on the probability.

To enter the Gem Cave, you need a 'Gem Cave Ticket'.

Here are the ways to obtain tickets:
[list]
[*]Dropped by regular monsters with a very low probability
[*]Dropped by enhanced monsters with a low probability
[*]Obtained as various event rewards
[*]Purchase tickets at Ms. Jang's shop

(Enemies in mini dungeons do not drop items. Also, only 1 enemy appears in a single battle.)

Monster's stat growth limit has been removed, so now all enemies can continue to get stronger.

[h2]Removal and adjustment of NG+ reward payment restrictions[/h2]

Previously, as enemies could only grow to NG+4, gold bars given as a reward for clearing the game could only be obtained up to NG+4.

[b]Now that monster growth limits have been removed, NG+ rewards can still be earned.[/b]

[b]There are currently 3 ways to obtain gold bars.[/b]
[list]
[*]Game Clear (Depends on current NG+)

[*]NG+4 : 8 Gold bars

notes.title: Executioner Girls Developer Notice
notes.content:
'Magic Sword Girl Twins' game build review has already made no progress for more than 50 days. Therefore, we decided that Steam was intentionally completely ignoring inquiries and support for our game, so we made the following decision.


[h2]Magic Sword Girl Twins Development Postponed indefinitely[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43799030/61380401808c0970624c46b373108eda9c5f99b6.png[/img]

Due to the change in Steam's policy regarding AI art as mentioned in the previous notice, our team has made a difficult decision to postpone the development of 'Magic Sword Girl Twins' indefinitely.

We didn't release much information, but I'm so sorry to disappoint everyone who looked forward to it and waited.

We are also very sorry to have to stop the project without even revealing our hard-prepared store pages.


[h2]Our current situation and development environment[/h2]

New development has been suspended, but the team is still busy.

It's a stopped project now, but the time and capital already spent on development cannot be reversed, so we have to work in a more difficult situation than before.


[h2]The idea of a new work[/h2]

We've started to come up with a new game that can respond to the changing policies. And this time, we set our goal to present an excellent gameplay experience instead of an anime girls.

Information on this new game will also be released sequentially depending on the development progress.

We considered recruiting illustrators, but we don't have that much financial space at the moment, so we decided to promise a far future.


[h2]Related to Executioner Girls Updates[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43799030/3c06735df61821cfb8a4344a736ecb9ee2cb2524.png[/img]

The update of the Executioner Girls will continue.

However, I can't guarantee you the speed of the update. Please just note that post-support for Executioner Girls continues for now.


That's all for this news.

We will now begin to develop new works in earnest.

Thank you for reading the long article.

- Karume
